title: Ubuntu Core Software Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description:
Ingeniero de Procesos Jr.

¿Estás buscando una empresa que trabaje en grandes proyectos de ingeniería en todo el mundo? ¿Quieres marcar la diferencia mejorando la vida diaria de las comunidades a nivel mundial? ¿Buscas unirte a un equipo inclusivo y diverso en el que realmente puedas confiar? ¡Has llegado al lugar correcto! Únete a nosotros para remodelar el futuro con AtkinsRéalis. AtkinsRéalis está dedicada a diseñar un futuro mejor para nuestro planeta y su gente. AtkinsRéalis es uno de los grupos de ingeniería nuclear del sector privado más grandes de Canadá. Hemos estado proporcionando una amplia gama de servicios a la industria nuclear en Canadá y en todo el mundo durante más de 60 años. Estamos orgullosos de ser los guardianes de la tecnología nuclear CANDU canadiense. AtkinsRéalis está buscando Ingenieros de Procesos para ser parte de nuestro equipo en el apoyo al diseño de nuevas plantas de energía nuclear y la operación y renovación de las plantas de energía nuclear CANDU existentes.

Ubicación – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Tu rol dentro del equipo:

  • Proporcionar soluciones de diseño y evaluaciones para sistemas de procesos, estructuras y componentes nuevos, actualizados y modificados.

  • Realizar diseño/análisis de sistemas hidráulicos y electromecánicos.

  • Proporcionar orientación técnica y liderazgo a ingenieros de niveles inferiores y/o a otros empleados técnicos.

  • Asegurar el cumplimiento del programa de calidad de la empresa.

  • Preparar y/o revisar Solicitudes de Cotización de Ingeniería y Evaluaciones Técnicas de Licitaciones.

  • Apoyar a la Gestión de Ingeniería con actualizaciones oportunas sobre el progreso de la ingeniería.

  • Asegurar que se cumplan los códigos, normas y requisitos regulatorios aplicables.

  • Proporcionar apoyo para la preparación de propuestas de ingeniería.

  • Interactuar con partes interesadas internas y externas según sea necesario.

¿Por qué elegir AtkinsRéalis como empleador? Porque ofrecemos:

  • Un entorno emocionante donde el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida personal es importante.

  • Una amplia gama de oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

  • Pago competitivo y beneficios flexibles.

  • Un entorno de trabajo enfocado en la salud y la seguridad.

El candidato ideal:

  • Título en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Nuclear o Ciencias de la Ingeniería de una universidad acreditada con un mínimo de 1 a 2 años de experiencia en diseño/análisis de sistemas de procesos, preferiblemente proporcionando soluciones de diseño para plantas de energía nuclear CANDU o mercados BWR/PWR.

  • Experiencia realizando trabajos según los procedimientos y prácticas de plantas de energía nuclear y calificaciones para actividades de ingeniería de plantas de energía nuclear es una ventaja.

  • Sólidos conocimientos técnicos de todos los aspectos que abarcan los procesos nucleares CANDU, análisis, equipos y control.

  • Experiencia realizando evaluaciones de balance de calor y termohidráulicas.

  • Experiencia en diseño y disposición de sistemas de procesos.

  • Conocimiento de herramientas analíticas utilizadas para el diseño mecánico y de procesos; por ejemplo, ANSYS, Mathcad, Flomaster, NUCIRC, CATHENA o similar.

  • Conocimiento práctico de/experiencia en el uso de Códigos y Normas nucleares, incluyendo CSA N285.0 y ASME Sección III.

  • Conocimiento práctico de/experiencia con la norma CSA B51, los códigos ASME B31.1 y otras normas o guías regulatorias aplicables a plantas de energía nuclear relacionadas con componentes permanentes de la planta, equipos de límites de presión y/o sistemas de reactores.

  • Debe tener excelentes habilidades de comunicación y redacción técnica en inglés.

  • Demostrar buenas habilidades interpersonales y la capacidad de trabajar en un entorno de equipo multidisciplinario.

  • La experiencia en el sitio en construcción o puesta en marcha de sistemas mecánicos de plantas para industrias nucleares u otras industrias pesadas es una ventaja.

  • Capaz de obtener una Autorización de Seguridad y pasar verificaciones policiales y de antecedentes que se realicen.

Junior Process Engineer

Are you looking for a company that works on major engineering projects all over the world? Do you want to make a difference by improving the daily lives of communities worldwide? Are you seeking to join an inclusive and diverse team that you can truly count on? You’ve come to the right place!

Come join us in reshaping the future with AtkinsRéalis. AtkinsRéalis is dedicated in engineering a better future for our planet and its people.

AtkinsRéalis is one of Canada's largest private sector nuclear engineering groups. We have been providing a wide range of services to the nuclear industry in Canada and around the world for more than 60 years. We are proud to be the steward of Canadian CANDU nuclear technology.

AtkinsRéalis is looking for Process Engineer(s) to be a part of our team in supporting the design of new nuclear power plants and the operation and refurbishment of existing CANDU nuclear power plants.

Location – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Your role within the team

  • Provide design solutions and assessments for new, updated and modified process systems, structures and components.

  • Performing design/analysis of hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems.

  • Provide technical guidance and leadership to engineers at lower grade levels and/or other technical employees.

  • Ensure adherence to company quality program.

  • Prepare and /or review design documents for Nuclear Power Plants; e.g., Design Calculation, Design Requirements, Assessments, Technical Specifications, Drawings, Bill of Materials, and System Code Classification.

  • Prepare and/or review Engineering Quotation Request and Tender Technical Evaluations.

  • Support Engineering Management with timely updates on engineering progress.

  • Perform walkdowns, attend site visits and meetings as required.

  • Ensure applicable code, standards and regulatory requirements are met.

  • Provide support for the preparation of Engineering proposals.

  • Interface with internal and external stake holders as required.

Why choose AtkinsRéalis as an employer?

Because we offer:

  • An exciting environment where work-life balance is important.

  • A wide array of learning and development opportunities.

  • Competitive pay and flexible benefits.

  • A work environment focused on health and safety.

The ideal candidate

  • Engineering degree from an accredited University in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering or Engineering Science with minimum of 1 to 2 years of experience in process-system design/analysis, preferably providing design solutions for CANDU nuclear power plants or BWR/PWR markets.

  • Experience performing work to nuclear power plants procedures and practices and qualifications for nuclear power plants engineering activities is an asset.

  • Strong technical knowledge of all aspects encompassing CANDU nuclear processes, analyses, equipment, and control.

  • Experience performing heat balance and thermohydraulic evaluations.

  • Experience in process system design and layout.

  • Knowledge of analytical tools used for mechanical and process design; e.g., ANSYS, Mathcad, Flomaster, NUCIRC, CATHENA or similar.

  • Working knowledge of/experience using nuclear Codes and Standards, including CSA N285.0 and ASME Section III.

  • Working knowledge of/experience with the CSA B51 standard, ASME B31.1 codes and other nuclear-power-plant applicable standards or regulatory guides related to permanent plant components, pressure boundary equipment, and/or reactor systems.

  • Must have excellent communication and technical writing skills in English.

  • Demonstrate good interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a multidisciplinary team environment.

  • Site experience in construction, or commissioning of plant mechanical systems for nuclear or other heavy industries is an asset.

  • Able to acquire Security Clearance and pass police and background checks that are conducted;

  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated and able to take ownership of projects without needing micromanagement.

  • Remote Readiness: Ability to thrive in a remote-first environment, managing time effectively and communicating clearly across distributed teams.

  • Passion for Learning: Eagerness to stay updated with the latest trends in frontend technologies and AI-driven products.

Opportunity:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking AI-driven team dedicated to enhancing personalized learning experiences. As a Frontend Engineer, you’ll help shape the future of the platform by building user-friendly, responsive, and scalable features. title: Product Owner
description:
Job description

Aqui na wBrain, não transformamos apenas organizações; evoluímos pessoas. Somos um ecossistema de profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e desafios.

Estamos à procura de pessoas como você. Futuros talentos. Mentes brilhantes e criativas. Gente que pensa fora da caixa e que tem a vontade de causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

O Product Owner (PO) é o responsável por definir a visão do produto, criar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, e garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento entregue funcionalidades de alto valor que atendam às necessidades do negócio e dos clientes. Ele atua como principal ponto de contato entre as partes interessadas (stakeholders) e a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo que o produto evolua de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades:

  • Visão e Estratégia do Produto:
    • Desenvolver e comunicar a visão do produto para a equipe e stakeholders.
    • Garantir que o desenvolvimento do produto esteja alinhado com os objetivos de negócios e as necessidades do mercado.
    • Manter uma visão clara e consistente do produto, e transmitir isso de forma eficaz para todos os envolvidos no projeto.
  • Gestão do Backlog:
    • Criar, priorizar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, garantindo que ele reflita as necessidades dos usuários e as prioridades de negócios.
    • Quebrar funcionalidades de alto nível em histórias de usuários detalhadas e bem definidas.
    • Refinar continuamente o backlog com base em feedbacks, novos insights e mudanças de mercado.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders:
    • Trabalhar de forma próxima com as partes interessadas (liderança de negócios, marketing, vendas e clientes) para obter requisitos e entender as necessidades do produto.
    • Traduzir o feedback dos stakeholders em histórias de usuários e requisitos claros.
    • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre o andamento do projeto para os stakeholders, incluindo prazos de entrega, prioridades e eventuais riscos.
  • Planejamento de Sprint e Execução:
    • Colaborar com o Scrum Master/agilista e a equipe de desenvolvimento no planejamento e execução das sprints.
    • Garantir que a equipe entenda claramente as histórias de usuário e requisitos, fornecendo detalhes suficientes para o desenvolvimento.
    • Ser o ponto de contato para a equipe durante a sprint, esclarecendo dúvidas e tomando decisões rápidas quando necessário.
  • Critérios de Aceitação e Testes:
    • Definir critérios de aceitação claros para as funcionalidades e histórias de usuário.
    • Revisar e aprovar as entregas para garantir que atendem aos critérios de aceitação.
    • Realizar testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT) e coordenar com os stakeholders para garantir que o produto atenda aos padrões exigidos antes do lançamento.
  • Melhoria Contínua:
    • Acompanhar o desempenho do produto e o feedback dos usuários para realizar melhorias contínuas.
    • Identificar de forma proativa áreas de melhoria, tanto no produto quanto nos processos de desenvolvimento.
    • Trabalhar com equipes de análise de dados para medir o sucesso do produto e ajustar as estratégias conforme necessário.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Boa compreensão técnica do produto e do processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em um domínio específico (e.g., aplicativos móveis, software corporativo, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em cargos similares em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Forte entendimento das metodologias e frameworks ágeis.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais para colaborar com stakeholders em todos os níveis.
  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (e.g., Jira, Trello, Slice ou similares).
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Familiaridade com a indústria ou mercado no qual a empresa atua (e.g., tecnologia, e-commerce, saúde) é um diferencial.
  • Certificação em Product Management ou Agile (por exemplo, Certified Scrum Product Owner - CSPO).
  • Experiência com plataformas ou produtos específicos (e.g., SaaS, e-commerce, produtos móveis, etc.).

Soft Skills:

  • Senso de urgência
  • Resiliência
  • Iniciativa/ Protagonismo
  • Capacidade de se adaptar e respeitar os processos e regras corporativas/globais
  • Coragem para conversas difíceis/comunicação assertiva
  • Organização
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Escuta ativa

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer for our OpenStack Engineering team. This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and OpenStack. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
As a software engineer on the OpenStack Engineering team, you'll be building Charmed OpenStack and Ceph, a suite of open source Python based charms for deploying and managing OpenStack and Ceph. Your work will bring cloud platform technologies to a wide range of users and computing environments, from desktops to bare metal servers. This role requires a python software developer with a passion for automating infrastructure as code.
Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.
What you'll do

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Ensure the success of OpenStack and Ceph on multiple architectures
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • You have experience with non-x86 architectures, including s390, arm64, power and others
  • You have experience with OpenStack, OVN, Openvswitch and other related cloud technologies
What Canonical Offers

  • Annual Compensation Review
  • Recognition Rewards
  • Annual Leave
  • Priority Pass for travel
  • Flexible working option
Canonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world's computing needs. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: Comprador
description:
A Equipeças é uma empresa sólida, que atua há mais de 15 anos no mercado atacadista de peças para caminhões.

Aqui celebramos nossas conquistas respeitando as individualidades de cada pessoa, pois reconhecemos cada indivíduo como único.

Também acreditamos que nossos clientes devem ser respeitados e atendidos da melhor forma possível, lhes oferecendo, além de produtos de qualidade e preços justos, uma experiência única de compra.

Estamos à procura de um profissional para fazer parte da nossa equipe de compras.

Essa pessoa terá a oportunidade de desenvolver suas atividades efetuando a compra de produtos para vendas e materiais diversos (autopeças de linha pesada, matéria-prima, insumos, embalagens, material de expediente, serviços etc.) abrangendo desde o contato com fornecedores, cotações e negociações até a emissão do pedido e acompanhamentos de entregas. Entre suas principais responsabilidades, está uma comunicação ativa com as lojas a fim de obter informações relevantes sobre demandas e necessidades de compras e reposições de mercadorias.

Se você se identifica com nossos valores e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa sólida, que está em constante crescimento e que acredita que as pessoas são a base de uma organização de sucesso, essa oportunidade tem tudo a ver com você!

Responsabilidades

  • Efetuar compras de produtos (autopeças de linhas pesadas - Caminhão) e materiais (matéria-prima, embalagens, material de expediente, insumos, serviços etc.) mediante solicitações via e-mail, programações periódicas ou acessando o sistema (SS Sistemas ): contatar fornecedores, cotar preços, condições de pagamentos e prazos de entrega e preparar mapas comparativos para apreciação e decisão da direção. Emitir os pedidos de compra através do próprio sistema ou e-mails e monitorar o andamento deles até a entrega dos produtos.
  • Receber visitas de fornecedores para a apresentação de novos produtos e aplicações, desenvolvimento de novas fontes de fornecimento de material para a empresa avaliando a similaridade de produtos, novas opções de compra. Eventualmente pode visitar fornecedores para observar as condições de produção e fornecimento dos produtos e materiais adquiridos para atender às especificações de qualidade da empresa. Relatar suas observações para conhecimento da direção e demais áreas interessadas.
  • Manter arquivo de catálogos e material promocional para pesquisa de produtos bem como de toda a documentação processada na área.
  • Semanalmente acessar o sistema e verificar, por unidade, os níveis de estoque para acompanhar os prazos de entrega podendo agilizá-los ou prorrogá-los junto aos fornecedores em função das necessidades e fluxo da demanda.
  • Periodicamente acessar o sistema e inserir cadastros de novos fornecedores e produtos bem como identificar os funcionários com autorização para a emissão das solicitações de compra e respectivas alçadas ou nível de autorização (valor da solicitação).
  • Preparar planilhas e quadros demonstrativos sobre o desempenho da área no pedido para apreciação e controle da direção.
  • Lançar Notas Fiscais de entrada no sistema informatizado da empresa.

  • Indicar novos fornecedores para futuras negociações.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Logística ou equivalentes.
  • Habilidades de negociações e comunicação.
  • Habilidades matemáticas.
  • Conhecimentos de processos de compras desde o início.
  • Conhecimento em cálculos de imposto IPI, ICMS, ST.
  • Será um diferencial ter conhecimentos em processos de Importações.
  • Conhecimento de intermediário ao avançado em informática, especialmente no Excel.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Administração do tempo.

  • Planejamento e controle.
  • Utilização de raciocínio lógico.
  • Visão estratégica.

  4. Apoiar o planejamento de campanhas e ações previstas em calendário através da execução dos planos de mídia, negociações e controle de prazos;
  5. Trabalhar para a eficiência operacional da área de trade marketing através da atuação com demais áreas como Marketing Nacional, Operações, Comerciais Regionais, Contas a Receber, Contabilidade, Tecnologia da informação (TI) e outras;
  6. Implementar as ações de concursos de vendas através do acompanhamento de sua execução, alinhamento junto aos fornecedores, monitoramento de metas de vendas e margem, assim como a consolidação de resultados;
  7. Atuar na ampliação de oportunidade de negócios através de relacionamento estratégico junto aos fornecedores, visando fortalecer os investimentos e representatividade da bandeira;
  8. Alinhar com os fornecedores a Ativação do Ponto de Venda através de campanhas que ampliem as vantagens competitivas e a experiência de compra dos clientes;
  9. Assegurar a negociação assertiva de ferramentas de Trade Marketing e Trade Digital através da apresentação de valores mínimos e máximos para propostas nacionais e regionais, dentro do padrão e regras da área;

  11. Acompanhar os avanços das plataformas de E-Commerce, Digital e Market-place, através do controle de indicadores e resultados destas ferramentas;
  12. Apoiar o processo de sistematização das Plataformas do Trade Marketing através do acompanhamento de novos sistemas de gestão e auditoria no PDV, projetos de melhorias operacionais e etc;
  13. Contribuir com o aumento das receitas e dos investimentos dos fornecedores de acordo com a representatividade da área de Trade Marketing e da a execução dos planos de mídia da bandeira;
  14. Desenvolver ações de Trade Marketing através do monitoramento de KPIs (Key Performance Indicator) para o desenvolvimento da função nas Regionais.

About Grupo Pereira

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, em Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem o propósito de "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor". Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos Estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e no Distrito Federal, o Grupo Pereira tem mais 125 unidades de negócio, sendo 31 lojas do Comper (rede de supermercados), 60 lojas do Fort Atacadista (atacarejo), 3 filiais do Atacado Bate Forte (atacadista de distribuição), 1 Broker (distribuidora da rede Nestlé), 23 lojas SempreFort (varejo farmacêutico), 5 lojas Pera Turismo (Agência de Viagens) e 2 postos de combustíveis. Completando o ecossistema de soluções para o cliente, também fazem parte dos negócios do Grupo Pereira o braço logístico Perlog e o de serviços financeiros Vuon, que inclui o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica. Com a missão de oferecer uma experiência de compra positiva por meio de excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e funcionários, o Grupo Pereira colabora com a sociedade por meio de diferentes programas socioambientais.

title: Engenheiro de Produção -  Cuiabá/MT
description:
A Mirandex começou sua história em meados de 1994, ainda como distribuidora de Vidros Brasil de Rondônia, atuando no ramo de distribuição de chapas e vidros em comum. Em 1998, começou a procura pelo vidro temperado no Estado, o que ainda era uma novidade. Desde então, começamos a revender o vidro temperado que era produzido nos grandes centros do país. O aumento da demanda, a dificuldade de compra e transporte, além do prazo de entrega, fizeram com que nos inspirássemos a montar uma indústria própria. Então em 2000, inauguramos nossa indústria de vidro temperado, a primeira do estado de Rondônia, com forno de têmpera vertical. Cada vez mais aquecido, o mercado exigia novos produtos e mais rapidez de entrega. Visando isso, em 2002 demos um grande passo ao adquirir um forno horizontal de tecnologia americana, que produzia vidros com mais rapidez e qualidade. Dessa forma, a Mirandex se torna a maior empresa do ramo vidraceiro da região Norte do Brasil.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades de produção, dentro das especificações e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos, visando a assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos da empresa na área comercial.
  2. Supervisionar a elaboração do plano anual de metas de produção, visando à otimização dos recursos produtivos disponíveis.
  3. Supervisionar a elaboração dos cronogramas de fabricação, visando a garantir a melhor alocação da mão-de-obra, equipamentos e materiais.
  4. Controlar as despesas gerais do departamento de produção (energia elétrica, custos de manutenção, insumos etc.), visando a contribuir para a redução de custos nesses itens.
  5. Analisar e avaliar os aspectos econômicos do processo produtivo, no tocante a mão-de-obra e quantidade de materiais consumidos, visando a identificar oportunidades ou alternativas que permitam a redução de custos.
  6. Elaborar procedimentos e determinar diretrizes para manutenção do visual da fábrica, no que se refere a limpeza, pintura, conservação etc., visando a manter o local em condições que propiciem o melhor desempenho dos funcionários e dos equipamentos.
  7. Estudar, desenvolver e/ou aperfeiçoar processos, equipamentos, ferramental etc., bem como estabelecer controles de processos, visando garantir melhor qualidade e maior produtividade. Acompanhar e controlar sistematicamente o desempenho da produção, por meio da análise de indicadores gerenciais apropriados, propondo os planos e ações necessários, visando assegurar o cumprimento das metas e objetivos estabelecidos.
  8. Supervisionar as atividades de inspeção de materiais e de controle de qualidade da matéria-prima, visando assegurar conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
  9. Supervisionar as atividades de estocagem de produtos acabados, visando assegurar conformidade com as especificações estabelecidas.
  10. Acompanhar a execução de auditorias, visando a identificar necessidades de alterações/modificações que permitam obtenção das certificações.

Senior Product Manager - Data and Analytics

Apply locations: São Paulo, Brazil; Curitiba, Brazil; Santa Fé, Mexico

Posted on: Posted 5 Days Ago

Job requisition id: R-134850

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.
  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical need.
  3. Advocate for and manage funding including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.
  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.
  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’ data landscape.
  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams using knowledge of both Mondelez business domain and technical expertise.
  7. Think strategically and connect stakeholder use cases to technology solutions while thinking holistically about the end-to-end experience.
  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  1. HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.
  2. LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen around you while proactively managing project ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.
  3. DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.
  4. BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.
  5. GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify/execute opportunities and leverage technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  6. CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  7. TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics – including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.
  8. EXPERIENCE with financial systems specifically SAP, SAC, and Hyperion a definite plus.
  9. INTEGRITY and sound judgement in all decisions and interactions aligned with our values and policies and external regulations.

More about this role

We are aware of our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, so diversity, equity and inclusion are one of our priorities. We believe in breaking down stereotypes and barriers to ensure the representation of society within our company. And for that, we have a Diversity Committee that operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women and LGBTQIAP+, in addition to being part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. You will use a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen to help Mondelez’ Finance organization build data and analytics products with an eye toward an AI-ready future. The products you drive will serve decision makers at the highest levels by improving our measurement and insight using Mondelez’ data. As the appetite for data and insight is growing within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insight to teams that need it.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  1. Management consulting a plus.
  2. Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  3. Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

Limited travel up to 20% of time.

Mondelez International is attentive to the future of work and values the well-being of our people, seeking to provide the best experiences. Therefore, some of our administrative vacancies are eligible for the hybrid model, allowing remote work on certain days of the week.

No Relocation support available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelēz Brasil is Mondelēz International’s fourth largest operation in the world, with approximately 7,500 employees proudly producing, selling and distributing some of the most beloved brands of chewing gum, candies, powdered beverages, cream cheeses, chocolates, cookies and desserts in Brazil. We make the Brazilians’ favorite products such as Bis, Lacta, Oreo, Club Social, Sonho de Valsa, Trakinas, Trident, Halls, Royal, Tang and many others. We are truly part of the lives of Brazilians: You can find our mouth-watering products in more than 700,000 points of sale and we are present in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão, in the state of Pernambuco, and Curitiba, in the state of Paraná. We are also home to one of the company's 11 technology centers around the world, responsible for research and development, so we can continue to create new and innovative products, offering the right snack for the right time, done in the right way.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Type

Regular Analytics & Modelling Analytics & Data Science

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right through offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broader range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands – both global and local. Including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the number 1 position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy as well as the No. 2 position in gum.

Our 80,000 Makers and Bakers are located in our operations in more than 80 countries and are working to sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. They are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen, and happen fast.

description:
Description

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Sr. Financial Analyst

The PIC (Principal, Inventory and Costing) Finance team is responsible for Inventory Management, complex financial transactions and flows, costing and intercompany pricing. PIC team ensures that all supply chain/cost transactions, analysis and reporting are accurate and compliant in line with Kenvue guidelines.

The Senior Financial Analyst will play a key role in ensuring a high-quality service delivery model through strong collaboration across the Business and Finance. In addition, understanding of the SC processes, systems and ability to effectively frame and communicate with senior leaders, will be important to success and to the team as a whole.

This position is based at São Jose dos Campos.

Who We Are

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA, AVEENO, TYLENOL, LISTERINE, JOHNSON’S and BAND-AID that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Our global team is made by 22,000 diverse and brilliant people, passionate about insights, innovation and committed to deliver the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means to have the power to impact life of millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future – and yours.

What You Will Do

The Senior Financial Analyst may be responsible for the following:

General PIC Responsibilities

  • Manage intercompany transactions and regional pricing
  • Support development of financial forecasts, perform closing activities and analyses of results.
  • Support analysis on manufacturing variances
  • Ensure compliance with all local government and company regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Business partnering (i.e. Tax, Compliance, Supply Chain, Leadership Teams)
  • Share business and financial best practices/procedures across the region
  • Focus on process improvement and standardization
  • Promote collaboration and uses best practices to provide strategic analytic support to the team and organization.
  • Participate in other special projects as needed
  • Perform other duties assigned as needed

PIC Costing Senior Financial Analyst:

  • Coordinate and perform annual costing, ICP, markup setup process
  • Execute business case modeling and support NPI analysis
  • Provide cost insights to the business through simulator
  • Support PnL Bridges and other financial metrics. Explain cost variances for global groups

PIC Inventory Senior Financial Analyst:

  • SLOB / FAA consolidation, DOS Calculation, Net Inventory Reports
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning to identify and mitigate future risks (Regional and Global Planning Governances)
  • Partner closely with Finance Partners (BUF, PF&A, Make, Source) to have robust knowledge on the end-to-end costing variation and inventory drivers
  • Lead FAA analyses and closing activities for FAA supply chain groups
  • Lead forecast cycles - FAA/ Inventory total global support

PIC Currency Senior Financial Analyst:

  • Ensure timely preparation and in-depth analysis of the currency impacts for budget updates and actuals
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of hedging exposures
  • Provide in-depth analysis for hedging and currency impacts
  • Manage supply chain currency exchanges and associated risks
  • Support analytics to drive cash flow and profitability

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s Degree is required in area related to Finance/ Accounting or Engineering/Business Management
  • 4-6 years of experience
  • Cost and Inventory accounting experience
  • Strong financial modeling skills
  • The ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions
  • The ability to identify, recommend and implement process improvements

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with systems mainly SAP / Microsoft Office / Business Intelligence Tools
  • Experience as Finance or related business partner
  • Advanced English is preferred (Spanish is a plus)
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Compliance background and experience

What’s In It For You

  • Competitive Benefit Package
  • Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
  • Learning & Development Opportunities
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • This list could vary based on location/region

description:
Do you want to help our customers to adopt cutting edge cloud computing technology, solve the biggest of “big data” problems, work with Internet scale distributed systems, and see the impact of your work with happy and successful customers?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth, business knowledge, and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers and several AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:

  1. Be great fun to work with. At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
  2. Enjoy working with customers of all shapes and sizes. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of customers ranging from small businesses to large enterprises. Expect to help our customers design flexible and scalable solutions, and work on some of the most complex challenges in large-scale computing.
  3. Have a strong understanding of computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in the computing industry. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new skills. You will help identify areas of existing architectural collateral that are incorrect or need updating in order to ensure customers can create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Build a strong foundation of knowledge around AWS cloud services and the cloud ecosystem
  2. Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS
  3. Assist with training sessions for customers considering or already using AWS
  4. Collaborate with experienced solutions architects to craft and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
  5. Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services, such as Elastic Compute Cloud, Elastic Block Storage, and Simple Storage Service. Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
  • Experience with solution-selling methodologies.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner and AWS Solutions Architect Associate certifications desired. Other public cloud provider's certifications are also welcome.

title: Family Nurse Practitioner
description:
Exciting Full-Time Family Nurse Practitioner Opportunity in Centre, Alabama!

MainStreet Family Care is growing, and we are looking to hire a fast, fun, and friendly Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) to join our team full time! You will provide patient focused care to help our patients feel better FAST! Boom! Services provided to the public include urgent care, primary medical care, telemedicine, and occupational medicine. The ideal applicant will be able to lead a small team while working in a high volume and fast-paced urgent care environment.

This is an incredible opportunity for FNPs early in their career – including BRAND NEW GRADS! (Still haven’t taken boards? That’s okay!) Following our on-site hosted HQ orientation and training, you will have several training shifts with existing providers in one of our clinics. But the support doesn’t end there! From a complimentary pediatric urgent care CE course to an NP on-call to help you with clinical decision making as you grow into the role, the support we have to help YOU achieve ultimate career success as a provider is unmatched. This is an investment we are making in you because we believe that you can succeed.

What else makes this opportunity unlike any other you may be scoping out?

Utilize your FULL scope of practice! You are a provider who can handle anything – and due to the nature of urgent care, anything may walk through the door. We do whatever we can within the scope of practice for a patient, no matter the age. You will be able to treat babies, kids, adults, and geriatric patients alike. Few other positions will allow you to exercise the full scope of care your program and RN experience prepared you to practice. This keeps skills sharp and makes you very marketable for future opportunities and growth in your nursing career. You will not regret the investment of time you are making reiterating your learned skills and putting them all together in an urgent care environment.

Be the LEADER on your team! Gone are the nursing days relying on a doctor on the floor to sign off on every little thing you do when caring for your patient. YOU are the medical provider in the clinic and able to treat your patients. Nervous about that? Fortunately, we have tons of treatment protocols ready to guide your decision-making of what is best practice for the patient. Your small team of medical assistants are there to support you, but you are also a leader and professional role model for them! Many report that one of the most rewarding parts of this role is being able to grow and inspire medical assistants to further their medical career.

Support our RURAL communities! MainStreet clinics service areas that need access to care. We are open 362 days a year because we know people still get sick on the weekends and don’t want to get stuck with a $1,500 ER bill. Since we care for communities with little access, most of our clinics qualify for tuition reimbursement grants or student loan reimbursement grants. This is a grant program funded by the state, and we are happy to support you in this application process to take advantage of these grant programs!

This isn’t just a step in your career – it’s a rocket ship build that will give you the launchpad to whatever success you envision for yourself. This is a commitment we are making to YOU for two years, and your two-year investment in yourself and the community will give you returns for years to come.

Responsibilities:

You and your team will care for every patient who comes through the door within your scope of practice. We do whatever we can for every patient. Some examples of care needed include:

  • Diagnosing and treating cold, flu, strep, COVID, and other upper respiratory issues
  • Minor procedures (toenail removal, foreign object removal, etc.)
  • Suturing
  • Splinting
  • General Orthopedic evaluations/management
  • Review of x-rays (to be over-read by Radiologist, too)
  • General Dermatology
  • General eye problems
  • General EKG interpretations
  • Emergency management skills
  • General GYN expertise
  • Treating children of all ages
  • Occupational medicine
  • Telemedicine

Schedule:

MainStreet Clinic Hours

We are open extended hours, 7-days-a-week:

  • Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m.
  • Saturday and Sunday 9:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.

Work a rotating schedule that includes every other weekend, sample below:

  • Week 1: Monday (ON), Tuesday (ON), Wednesday (OFF), Thursday (OFF), Friday (ON), Saturday (ON) and Sunday (ON).
  • Week 2: Monday (OFF), Tuesday (OFF), Wednesday (ON), Thursday (ON), Friday (OFF), Saturday (OFF) and Sunday (OFF).

Qualifications:

  • MSN, or higher education required (New graduate friendly!)

About the project:

As a Jira Cloud Administrator , you will serve as the go-to expert for JIRA at the client, handling requests, defining solutions, prioritizing tasks, and implementing improvements directly within the platform. A strong technical foundation is essential, as well as management skills and the autonomy to operate proactively.

How your day-to-day work will look like

Act as the primary owner and point of contact for JIRA within the organization.

Administer, configure, and optimize JIRA projects, workflows, permission schemes, custom fields, automations, and dashboards.

Receive internal requests, evaluate options, assess impact, and implement technical solutions within JIRA.

Manage multiple simultaneous requests, effectively prioritizing and responding to critical needs.

Coordinate with security, development, product, and other teams to align JIRA configurations with cross-functional requirements.

Drive continuous improvement within the platform, aligning with ITSM/Agile best practices.

Document configurations, decisions, and internal processes for traceability and scalability.

Promote JIRA adoption across teams and act as an enabler for efficient usage of the tool.

Elevate the use of JIRA to a strategic level, participating in planning and decision-making processes.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

4+ Years of experience working in Jira Cloud administration: Advanced experience configuring permission schemes, custom workflows, automation rules, custom fields, and notification schemes.

2+ Years of experience working with JQL and Automation: Skilled in building complex filters and automation rules using built-in tools or third-party plugins like Automation for Jira.

2+ Years of experience working with JIRA Software and JIRA Service Management: Proficient in both environments, with capability to integrate development and support workflows.

2+ Years of experience working with Security & Compliance: Experience collaborating with GRC or InfoSec teams to implement secure and compliant JIRA configurations.

2+ Years of experience working with Integrations: Experience integrating JIRA with other tools (Confluence, Slack, Git, internal systems or APIs.

2+ Years of experience working with Agile and ITSM Practices: Familiarity with implementing Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and service management processes within JIRA.

Experience with specific Jira add-ons (e.g., Tempo, ScriptRunner, Confluence).

Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Experience with multi-site restaurant, retail, grocery, and/or fuel projects is highly preferred.

  • Responsible for meeting project schedules, deadlines, and commitments for all projects.

  • Notifies supervisor of changes in project scope and advises if a change order proposal is needed.
  • Possesses a working knowledge of building codes and ADA requirements.

  • Accountable for resolving plan review comments from code officials.

  • 3+ years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of architectural principles, practices, and advanced techniques.
  • Expertise in drawings, specifications, and building materials.
  • Capable of completing complicated and difficult architectural assignments and large, complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute and coordinate multiple projects at a time.
  • Experience in multi-site projects preferred.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD (required), Revit (required), Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Photoshop, SketchUp, Smartsheet, 3Ds Max is a plus.
  • Architectural License or pursuing, highly preferred.

Language & Collaboration Requirements:
This role requires full professional fluency in English, including reading, writing, and speaking. Candidates must be comfortable working in an English-speaking environment and regularly communicating with U.S.-based colleagues and clients. All meetings, documentation, and project coordination will be conducted in English. Candidates must be available to work standard U.S. business hours.

This role is remote based and will work closely with Architects, Designers, Engineers, and clients in the U.S. Multi-shift work may often be required to accomplish work to meet aggressive schedules. title: CONSULTOR INTELIGENCIA SUPRIMENTOS
description:
Professional Areas Procurement & Supply Chain

Louis Dreyfus Company is in the middle of a company transformation program (named BOLD) focused on back office processes starting with Finance, Procurement and integration schemes with the group front office systems. The objectives of such strategic project are to enhance steering capabilities, increase control / compliance and improve efficiency through the implementation of group wide core model processes supported by standard organization principles and a single ERP (SAP S/4Hana completed by SAP Ariba).

The procurement function is expected through the project completion, based on the implementation of a single operating model, to reinforce their ability to deliver LDC on the addressable spend (approx. $1,2bn globally) with the following value pillars:

  • Continuity: Define appropriate category strategies and drive supplier performance to reduce supply related operational risks
  • Efficiency: Improve efficiency of the purchase to invoice flow through integrated end to end processes
  • Control: Increase cost / budget control and Reduce fraud risks based on policies and continuous controls
  • Savings: Deliver cost reduction and avoidance based on category strategy, market intelligence and rigorous vendor selection process

As part of this journey which has been going on for the last years, LDC designed and built such solution core model and initiated its roll out through the deployment of in various countries such as Germany, France, Uruguay, Switzerland, Argentina and United States. Next phase of the project which is planned to last 4 years will be focused on deploying the solution to all the geographies LDC operates in to collect the expected value.

The Procurement BPO - NLT will be in charge, for North Latam region (Brazil) and within the program team and organization, of leading ‘hands on’ from a functional standpoint the deployment of ‘BOLD procurement’ (processes, systems and operating principles) and owning the procurement processes within the country (Source to Contract and Purchase to pay with underlying Master Data Management) with a constant focus on the macro project and function objectives towards value creation for the company.

Such activities shall be performed in full alignment with the core / global BOLD program team and in coordination with key country stakeholders within and outside of the procurement function (IT, Procurement Subject Matter Experts, finance / Account Payable teams, master data teams, industry teams…).

Initial focus will be given to lead analysis, identify gaps, plan strategy and oversee the project execution to guarantee a smooth transition between the current Brazil ERP (Tango) used in all Platforms to the BOLD project environment. This project is expected to last 3 years and will be followed by the implementation of the remaining Source to Contract and Purchase to Pay processes as part of the larger ERP implementation.

The success of the project is foundational for the procurement team to reach the next maturity level towards improved value creation for LDC.

As an additional context information, LDC procurement addressable scope in North Latam is worth approximately $380m spent across four main (mostly) indirect spend categories such as Industry Supplies (Chemicals, Energy, Packaging), Industry operations (spare parts, maintenance services, outsourced labors and various other services), Projects (Greenfield, Brownfield, SHE…) and G&A expenses.

Job Description

The Procurement Process Owner - North LATAM will be accountable for the realization of the expected procurement related benefits in the country across the full addressable spend and will need to maintain the focus on value creation for the company across each and every activity.

Across the various phases of the project, the role will be responsible for the following:

  • Perform the discovery phase to guarantee the right project implementation according to LDC necessities identifying the Gaps / Improvements between the current version of Tango to the new version of BOLD
  • Identify, mobilize, align and maintain the appropriate procurement stakeholders network (in/outside the country, in/outside the function, in/outside the project, in/outside the company - ie suppliers where impacted) and ensure the knowledge of such network on the project objectives, scope, content… remains at the level it needs to be,
  • Build, maintain and execute the Organization Change Management plan which shall consist of a proper impact analysis of BOLD operating model in the country on process, system and people together with proper action plan for any identified gap (where such actions can be either process modification, system development or organization adjustments)
  • Drive the functional requirements articulation to a maximal adoption of the core model (or possibly enrichment of such core model) and an adaptation to the country needs to the extent such adaptation is value driven on a case by case and really needed, either driven by legal / regulatory constraint or specific value drivers,
  • As part of the LDC group wide procurement BPOs network, contribute to the enrichment of the global core model so that such core model keeps fitting to what the company needs over the time,
  • Where system localization is needed and approved, ensure requirements are properly articulated / documented so that it can be seamlessly delivered by project ‘factories’ and any delivery is tested properly,
  • Develop, implement through initial and continuous training and manage solution Key Users across all the processes at stake (Purchase to Pay, Source to Contract and Master Data related), to support the initial project, run and continuous enhancements activities,
  • Adopt (adapt where needed) and execute the appropriate training strategy towards both key users and end users, for all types of users (requesters, approvers, receivers, buyers, AP clerks, Master Data clerks…)
  • Perform and coordinate the end-to-end solution testing, relying on the above mentioned Key Users network and feed the core teams with documented outcomes and feedback,

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Together with analytics team leaders, you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

How you will contribute

  • Provide technical leadership for our data and analytics product roadmap, translating business requirements into achievable technical architectures.

  • Provide hands-on leadership to technical staff including code reviews, dashboard design reviews, and analysis guidance.
  • Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

More about this role

We are aware of our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, so diversity, equity and inclusion are one of our priorities. We believe in breaking down stereotypes and barriers to ensure the representation of society within our company. And for that, we have a Diversity Committee that operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women and LGBTQIAP+, in addition to being part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Lead to drive our data and analytics product team's technical vision and execution. This role bridges technical excellence and hands-on development with strategic product thinking, ensuring our data platforms and AI solutions deliver exceptional value. You'll lead a team of talented data and analytics professionals while collaborating with product managers and business stakeholders to build scalable, innovative solutions that transform how Mondelez leverages data.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • EXPERT-LEVEL SQL proficiency, including query optimization.
  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen around you while proactively managing project ambiguity, complexity and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.
  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.
  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.
  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics – including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.
  • HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE integrating LLM/AI capabilities into data and analytics products.
  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems specifically SAP, SAC, and Hyperion a definite plus.
  • INTEGRITY and sound judgement in all decisions and interactions aligned with our values and policies and external regulations.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Management consulting a plus.

Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.

Travel requirements:

Limited travel up to 20%.

Mondelez International is attentive to the future of work and values the well-being of our people, seeking to provide the best experiences. Therefore, some of our administrative vacancies are eligible for the hybrid model, allowing remote work on certain days of the week.

No Relocation support available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelēz Brasil is Mondelēz International’s fourth largest operation in the world, with approximately 7,500 employees proudly producing, selling and distributing some of the most beloved brands of chewing gum, candies, powdered beverages, cream cheeses, chocolates, cookies and desserts in Brazil. We make the Brazilians’ favorite products such as Bis, Lacta, Oreo, Club Social, Sonho de Valsa, Trakinas, Trident, Halls, Royal, Tang and many others. We are truly part of the lives of Brazilians: You can find our mouth-watering products in more than 700,000 points of sale and we are present in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão, in the state of Pernambuco, and Curitiba, in the state of Paraná. We are also home to one of the company's 11 technology centers around the world, responsible for research and development, so we can continue to create new and innovative products, offering the right snack for the right time, done in the right way.

description:
São Paulo - SP

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem, através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais;
  2. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações baseadas nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente e, ao término do plantão, informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional;
  3. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE), estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre a equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura, podendo este prestar assistência integral da escala de atividades e dimensionar diariamente a cobertura dos diversos setores sempre que necessário.
  5. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, dos treinamentos e eventos pertinentes, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares;
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes no HSC;
  7. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto à equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes às boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador realizando acompanhamento e treinamento dos colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício da mesma função assistencial;
  8. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  9. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada;
  10. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
  11. Contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e na elaboração e implementação de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares;
  12. Encaminhar os pacientes para o centro cirúrgico, checando o pré-operatório de acordo com o diagnóstico do paciente por meio de ferramenta sistematizada (SAEP- Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Peri operatória) para garantir a segurança de acordo com as metas internacionais;
  13. Promover e difundir medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente.

INSTITUIÇÃO

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

This is a full time, onsite role at our Bethlehem, PA facility.

Company Background:

ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. Position Summary:

Automation Technicians work under the direction of the Automation Supervisor and utilize independent judgment to perform the day-to-day project duties of designing, developing, commissioning and testing control system deliverables used in the fabrication of equipment for pilot and commercial scale biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Primary responsibility involves generating design documents and control system software along with troubleshooting installations during in-house testing and site installations. This position requires a high level of attention to detail along with good troubleshooting abilities.

  1. Work under the direction of an automation engineer lead.
  2. Execute quality management plan in accordance with quality standards.
  3. Understand all project requirements and objectives.

  7. Forecast and communicate status as required.
  8. Support design and manufacturing with integration of system controls as requested.
  9. Perform instrument setup and calibration as required.
  10. Program PLC, OIT, HMI, DCS controllers and smart instruments as requested.
  11. Setup and troubleshoot network/communication protocols such as Ethernet, Profibus, DeviceNet, etc.
  12. Assist with control system equipment setup and commissioning.
  13. Assist with Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
  14. Assist Automation and Electrical engineers in troubleshooting process control issues.
  15. Troubleshoot interface of field instruments with control systems at factory and site.
  16. Evaluate and recommend automation upgrades to existing equipment or systems.

  18. Maintain organized project and/or software records.

Requirements:

  1. 2+ years working with automation systems, instrumentation, networks, various transducers/sensors, transmitters, wiring, panel wiring, troubleshooting, etc.

  3. Associates Degree in Electrical/Electronics or related discipline or equivalent automation related job experience preferred.
  4. Thorough understanding of Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), wiring diagrams and instrumentation.

  7. Familiar with Microsoft Office applications.
  8. English language proficiency, both written and oral speaking skills.
  9. Bio-Pharm or Pharmaceutical industry experience preferred.
  10. Detail oriented with a solid understanding of current programming standards, industry design fundamentals, and related simulation/de-bugging processes.

  12. Electrical and Instrumentation relevant college courses.
  13. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  14. Good organizational skills with the ability to multi-task across functional groups.
  15. Must work well both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  16. Limited travel will be required. International travel possible.
  17. Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  18. Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Area

Our Marketing team is the technical engine driving Tractian's story, translating advanced industrial solutions into clear, impactful benefits for our customers. Covering every touchpoint – from acquisition to long-term engagement – we focus on customer impact, developing content that resonates with engineers and maintenance teams.

What will you do

As a Full Stack Developer in our Marketing team, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and scaling Tractian’s digital platforms and web properties. You’ll work closely with our Product, Growth, and Marketing teams to implement robust web experiences, improve automation workflows, and ensure seamless integrations across platforms. You’ll play a key role in developing high-performance, secure, and maintainable solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain front-end (React/NextJS, Tailwind CSS) and back-end (Node/NestJS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Prisma ORM) solutions.
  • Develop and optimize marketing automation workflows, including pixel tracking, lead scoring, UTM tracking, and CRM integrations.
  • Ensure seamless integrations between web properties, ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), and analytics tools (Google Tag Manager, PostHog, Amplitude).
  • Automate marketing and web workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Optimize SEO, performance, and conversion rates (CRO) across web properties.
  • Ensure website security, session management, and authentication protocols.
  • Implement and improve analytics, performance tracking, and A/B testing to support data-driven decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Growth teams to align web initiatives with company goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in web development, including hands-on experience with Typescript, Node.js, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Strong knowledge of React/NextJS, Tailwind CSS, and responsive web design.
  • Solid understanding of web security, authentication, and best development practices.
  • Expertise in web performance optimization, automation, and scaling digital experiences.
  • Experience leading teams, mentoring developers, and fostering an engineering-first culture.
  • Expertise in lead scoring models, behavioral tracking, and predictive analytics to enhance demand generation efforts.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with marketing automation, personalization, and CRO strategies.
  • Experience with MarTech stacks and automation tools to optimize digital marketing operations.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with data-driven growth strategies and A/B testing.
  • Strong analytical mindset, leveraging data to refine UX, conversion paths, and web automation.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

  • Realizar diagnósticos e demonstrações de propostas comerciais de forma consultiva;
  • Trabalhar em equipe, trocando aprendizados e alinhando estratégias com outros membros do time de vendas.

  • Histórico de sucesso em negociações e prospecção de contas de médio a grande porte;
  • Graduação completa em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia, negócios ou administração;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida: 70% do tempo em campo (externo) e 30% interno;
  • Facilidade com o uso de ferramentas de CRM e com relatórios de vendas;
  • Habilidades em comunicação, negociação e gestão de relacionamentos com clientes de diferentes níveis hierárquicos.
